notes.title: Update !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone :)

I updated the game to balance the difficulty and remove a bug from switching language.
I hope it will improve your experience with the game.

I would like to see your review about the game on the steam page so don't be shy ;)

notes.title: UPDATE: FIX
notes.notes:
I updated Paralysis description because the text was off.

Also, I added advices to help players with tips for a better strategy.
I met several players having problems with the difficulty of the game.
I admit the game is hard to master if it's not your kind at all.

I hope these hints will help players to understand what they could change in their strategy to solve the puzzle-combats.

Thanks for being in our community ;)

notes.title: UPDATE: Game Balance
notes.notes:
Today, I updated Pharmakon to provide a better gaming experience. I balanced some aspects of random generation in the game to avoid combat dead ends.

If you already got and played the game and you felt random generation was unfair. You can try again ;)
